create_graph_with_nodes_and_arcs: create a gtn Graph, add start and accept nodes, then add arcs with labels and weights
get_and_set_graph_weights: get arc weights as a list or numpy array and set new weights on a gtn Graph
compare_graphs_for_equality_and_isomorph: use gtn.equal and gtn.isomorphic to compare two graphs for exact equality or structural isomorphism
save_and_load_graphs: save a gtn Graph to disk with gtn.savetxt or gtn.save and load it back with gtn.loadtxt or gtn.load
run_autograd_backward_pass: create graphs with calc_grad enabled, apply gtn.add or gtn.negate, then call gtn.backward to compute gradients
